contract.question: Does the intrinsic D_A rank-clock width follow the quarter-power finite-regime prediction or the fixed critical-width prediction at a third homothetic scale?
contract.primary_readout: Centered second moment of the signed rank-step profile D_A=P4[A_top](4i)-P4[A_top](2i), in z=N^(3/8)(p-p_ref), with full same-counter batch covariance and area normalization uncertainty.
contract.sampling: One new N900 counter block shared by the two shapes, independent of N100/N400. 32M distinct counters and 64M geometry-pair evaluations. No adaptive extension or result-dependent truncation.
contract.geometry: Each N100 period entry is multiplied by three. Same moduli and rational rotation; both pairs have Smith(3,300)/(15,60). The shear geometry is omitted because this question concerns the already named D_A width, not common three-shape transport.
contract.resource: Two existing-engine single-threaded processes on the local Mac; no cloud/GPU rental or engine change.
contract.interpretation: Both candidates are conditional finite-regime shape predictions selected from N100/N400, not established critical exponents. Include target sampling uncertainty and the perfectly correlated shared N400 anchor. Either, both, or neither may be incompatible; do not force a winner or call an unresolved comparison model recovery.
secondary_readouts: fixed-p A/E/C/W and exact full threshold histograms
N400-to-N900 finite effective width and area-normalized mean location
source-defined auxiliary standardized shape moments if independently declared before target reveal

effective_width_400_900.scope: Finite N400-to-N900 signed-profile effective width; not an asymptotic exponent.
